load_hiplot_experiment: run a HiPlot server to visualize experiment metrics and history from Dora experiment signatures
create_custom_explorer: create a custom HiPlotExplorer subclass to select a subset of metrics for visualization
process_metrics_explorer: process experiment metrics through a HiPlotExplorer to filter or transform metric data
flatten_nested_dict: flatten a nested dictionary into a flat dictionary with dot-separated keys for HiPlot datapoints
round_float_precision: round a float value to a specified precision for cleaner display in HiPlot visualizations
